notes: Inbound AI receptionist plans: no contract, cancel anytime. The Done for You! price is a starting price ("Starting at $1,500 — inquire for a quote", line 152); included minutes and overage are listed as "Inquire for details" (lines 158, 164). Outbound plans are priced by contacts, not minutes, and are separate from inbound plans. Their overage is not stated; custom outbound plans are available on request (lines 278-279). Line 328 says "Prices shown are monthly. Annual pricing available." No annual prices are given. The page lists a phone number cost FAQ (line 314) but does not state the cost. All plans include a US-based phone number (local or toll-free). UK, AU, NZ, and international numbers are available on request (line 114). Line 303 mentions white-label/partner pricing with custom per-partner pricing, but no amounts are given. The usage estimator example (lines 130-135) shows 150 minutes → Business Pro, $99.00.
